sessions_audited.notes: Five documented cases retained; no overflow. One scope-reduction finding is alleged because the client stated the required final length and the agent did not confirm the contradiction.
Four documented cases retained; no overflow. The two missed-ETA cases have stated elapsed amounts.

cases.summary: The agent's copy-paste prompt specified a 60-second final ad. The client stated that the required ad was 90 seconds, not 60 seconds.
cases.agent_quote: Edit this into a finished 60-second Meta ad for a premium longevity brand.
cases.client_quote: Your entire prompt is wrong, though. It's a 90-second ad; it's not 60 seconds.

cases.agent_quote: Captions are now Instrument Serif — Julie's card font — in both films. No Inter, no Playfair, no mixing. … The captions in that MP4 are burned in. No tool re-fonts baked pixels.
cases.client_quote: captions fonts in julie and cortney are the same must be as julies acards ffonts. theres a lot of mistakes ceweo asked to fix u didnt mention

V24 is the approved master you presented, published today 12:14 IDT.

cases.summary: The agent provided a link labeled as the Courtney v16 90-second storyboard. It then confirmed that the linked GitHub storyboard's header read v18 and was mislabeled in the release.

cases.summary: The agent committed to Julie V23 and Courtney v16 being live by 08:33 IDT. It later reported shipment at 08:47 IDT.
cases.agent_quote: Sending notification: ETA 08:33 IDT — Julie V23 + Courtney v16 live … SHIPPED 08:47. All three tabs live.
cases.client_quote: I need an ETA, and I need it perfect. Now.

cases.summary: The agent committed to a 09:20 IDT delivery and stated that the delivery was at 09:22, two minutes past the ETA.
cases.agent_quote: 18 render jobs are live on GitHub's runners right now. Run 30979905067. ETA 09:20 IDT. … Everything is live on the one link. 09:22 — two minutes past. Recovery is in the delivery below, not in an excuse.

cases.summary: The agent said it had retested every sent link after the client's team encountered a 404. It then admitted it had provided a base folder path that GitHub did not serve.
cases.agent_quote: Whatever URL produced that 404, it isn't one of the live ones. I just re-tested every link I sent you … The 404 was mine: I handed over a base folder path that GitHub does not serve.
cases.client_quote: No, no, what don't you understand? I just had my Meta team try to enter. The link. And this is what they get: my .
